gaps: Temporal anomalies in Nov 2016 and late 2018

query: "olist" "november 2016" OR "september 2018" OR "october 2018" "delivered"
purpose: Investigate November 2016 gap and late 2018 right-censoring
outcome: Confirmed Nov 2016 operational pause (0 orders); confirmed dataset cutoff in Aug 2018 makes Sep-Oct 2018 a truncated tail (20 orders, 0 delivered)

query: "olist" "payment_value" "freight_value" "price" difference OR discrepancy OR voucher
purpose: Identify mathematical causes for payment discrepancies and 1:N join inflation
outcome: Identified join fan-out trap (items x payments), platform vouchers/coupons, multi-item freight rounding, and partial cancellations
gaps: Review duplication across multiple orders

query: "olist_order_reviews_dataset" "review_id" duplicate OR "multiple orders"
purpose: Analyze why review_id duplicates across orders and evaluate composite key vs entity+bridge modeling
outcome: Found that survey automation mapped identical review_ids to multi-order purchases; silent deduplication drops feedback for ~800 orders
gaps: Brazilian e-commerce terminology for buyout vs delivery

query: "ecommerce brasil" "taxa de devolucao" OR "logistica reversa" "status do pedido"
purpose: Check whether Brazilian e-commerce uses buyout concepts and identify logistics semantics
outcome: Confirmed Brazilian e-commerce has ~12-20% return rate and reverse logistics, but Olist dataset tracks courier delivery without returns/buyout events
gaps: None

query: site:github.com olist dbt "fact_orders" OR "fact_order_items" OR "dim_customers"
purpose: Survey public dbt architectures and star schema implementations for Olist
outcome: Identified prominent Kimball dimensional models, showing standard division into fct_orders, fct_order_items, and dim_customers.
gaps: Exact handling of review fanouts and payment discrepancies requires inspecting SQL models.

query: site:github.com olist "order_reviews" ("payment_value" OR "order_payments") fanout OR "one-to-many" OR "many-to-many"
purpose: Investigate join fanout between orders, payments, reviews, and items in community implementations
outcome: Confirmed Cartesian fanout issue (1:N payments, 1:N reviews). Common community workarounds use pre-aggregation or arbitrary row_number() deduplication.
gaps: Need to inspect raw model files to see if payload is lost during review deduplication.
